purpose: rev0336 schema registry for structured examples while the owner rail, field handoff bundle, and teacher/tutor micro-pilot source-result hashlink/fresh-packet path remain non-evidence until real human events and separate accepted evidence routing.
source_of_truth_rule: Every schemas/*.schema.json file must appear exactly once in CUBE_SCHEMA_REGISTRY.json; every registered validator must be wired through CUBE_TOOLCHAIN_REGISTRY.json; examples and root-control JSON must not become ungoverned structured evidence.
coverage_rules: All schemas/*.schema.json files are registered exactly once.
Every registered schema has at least one matching instance glob.
Every examples/**/*.json file is covered by exactly one registered schema row.
Every registered instance matched by instance_globs validates against its declared Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema.
Every registered validator exists and is listed in CUBE_TOOLCHAIN_REGISTRY.json lint_order.
Every registered doc_surface exists and is indexed by SURFACES.json when it is Markdown.
Schema registry coverage proves structured-artifact governance only; it does not close FT-0181 or prove service effectiveness.
Root metadata controls such as CUBE_SURFACE_CONTRACTS.json must have schema, validator, and prose-surface coverage.
Returned owner-reply triage tooling may classify intake, but schema coverage and CLI outcomes are not SRC2+ evidence and do not close FT-0181.
Owner-reply outcome routes may direct triage results to workbench, re-ask, or outcome note templates, but they are not SRC2+ evidence and do not close FT-0181.
Send-now briefs and scratch overwrite states are not schema evidence and do not close FT-0181 or prove service claims.
First-packet decision-board scratch records may route to a post-decision change ticket, but schema coverage and local board tooling are not SRC2+ evidence and do not close FT-0181.
Owner-route-block scratch artifacts may be validator-covered executable controls without becoming schema evidence, SRC2+ owner evidence, contact clocks, or closure.
Owner-reask-log scratch artifacts may be validator-covered executable controls without becoming schema evidence, SRC2+ owner evidence, delivery proof, contact details, or closure.

Activation receipt and source-truth labels in examples or scratch artifacts do not make candidate packets accepted SRC2 evidence, live-window authorization, or closure without the guarded owner field path.
Activation receipt scratch artifacts may gate active_change ticketing without becoming schema evidence, custody evidence, public-summary support, or FT-0181 closure.

Live-window terminal-state brief surfaces may compress staged/active card handoff to terminal card command skeletons only; they do not record terminal cards, readouts, service-record changes, public claims, custody, acceptance, lifecycle moves, or FT-0181 closure.

Live-window readout brief surfaces may compress terminal-readout-to-post-readout-action handoff only; they do not record readouts, dispatch post-readout actions, mutate service records, support public claims, create custody/acceptance, move lifecycle state, or close FT-0181.
